title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - WorkCenter
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/WorkCenter . A subclass of s4inma:ProductionEquipment (and therefore of the external s4bldg:PhysicalObject): an equipment element under an area in a role-based equipment hierarchy that performs production, storage or material movement (definition taken from IEC 62264). An Area contains work centers. Disjoint with s4inma:Area and s4inma:Site per the ontology's AllDisjointClasses axiom. Subclass of s4inma:ProductionEquipment per the SAREF4INMA ontology; inherited properties are documented on the ProductionEquipment model and not repeated here (the ttl declares no additional own property for WorkCenter).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WorkCenter'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. Not a literal OWL data property of s4inma:WorkCenter in the ttl; added for usability as a human-readable label (e.g. 'Welding WorkCenter'), matching how work center instances are named in the ETSI TS 103 410-5 worked example (ex:Welding_WorkCenter).
